chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, and Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, altogether from Ibn Abi Najran, from Asim ibn Humayd, from Abu Baseer, who said:
I asked Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) about the Mut'ah.
So he said: It was revealed in the Quran.
Then as to those whom you enjoy with, give them their dowries as appointed;
and there is no blame on you about what you mutually agree after what is appointed.
ai.seo_question: What is the Quranic evidence for temporary marriage (Mut'ah) in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi explicitly links the institution of Mut'ah to the Quranic verse 4:24, affirming its validity as a permanent ruling (not abrogated) in Shia jurisprudence. It clarifies that the 'ujrah' (dowry) is a fixed obligation, while the phrase 'what you mutually agree upon' allows for flexibility in additional terms or conditions, reflecting the contractual nature of the union.
